next.reason: 1985: "the program flow of control is undefined unless the program execution is in the nondeclarative procedures portion of a program under control of a CALL"; 2023: "There is also no next executable statement after the last statement in a source element ... an implicit GOBACK statement without any optional phrases is executed.". 1985 left flow undefined except in a called program's nondeclaratives (implicit EXIT PROGRAM). 2023 defines it: implicit GOBACK, or abnormal termination after fatal-exception declaratives.
